attacks.name: Ten Thousand Shapes Strike
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!mystic|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!critical| |!block| |!failure| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

attacks.name: Rising Phoenix Kick
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

superPowers.name: Hidden Flower Under the Leaves
superPowers.body: |*Action| : This character makes a move action followed by a |*Ten Thousand Shapes Strike| attack. This superpower can only be used once per turn.

superPowers.name: Dragon Chases Its Tail
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, if the attacking character is within |!range| 2 and this character did not suffer |!damage| from the attack, this character may use this superpower. Throw the enemy character |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Five Elements Fist
superPowers.body: When this character makes a |*Ten Thousand Shapes Strike| attack, before |!damage| is dealt, it may use this superpower. Choose and resolve 1 of the following effects:|~&*Flow like Water&: This character Advances &!movement_small&||~&*One-inch Punch&: Choose an enemy character within &!range& 1 and of &!size& 3 or less. Push the chosen character Away &!movement_small&.|

superPowers.name: Supreme Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an attack targeting it from within |!range| 3, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

This character may Advance |!range_small|. Then Place the attacking character within |!range| 1 of this character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Healthy side.
Ten Thousand Shapes Strike's Stagger special rule now triggers on |!critical| |!block| |!failure| instead of only |!critical| |!block|.

Five Elements Fist and Sixty-Four Infinite Palms now trigger before |!damage| is dealt instead of after the attack is resolved. Their One-Inch Punch effect range decreased from 2 to 1 and no longer inflicts Stun.
Sixty-Four Infinite Palms' |!power| cost increased from 1 to 2.
Wild Goose Leaves the Flock's timing changed from when the character is targeted to when the attack is resolved.
